prompt: Write 10 distinct lessons the claims-triage agent (home and motor claims assessment within delegated authority) at Larkmere Mutual learned across many cases about: a damaged shed or outbuilding. Each is a working pattern or tip for the next case, not about any one member, one or two sentences, in the agent's voice ("When…, …"). Return {"items": [{"type": "fact" | "preference" | "observation", "content": "..."}]} with exactly 10 items. (batch 2)

outbuilding."},{"type":"fact","content":"When the damage comes from an escaped water leak rather than weather, I look for the source, the time the leak was active and whether the shed was insulated or heated, because frost and pipework failures can change the repair approach."},{"type":"observation","content":"When a shed is detached and the loss is minor, I keep the claim handling proportionate
